title: Last entry of a marked block carries the marker flag
statement: Let $w$ be a natural number and let $b$ be a list of pairs in $\mathrm{Fin}\,w \times \{\mathrm{true},\mathrm{false}\}$, and suppose that its marked form — the list of triples obtained by appending to each entry a marker flag that is $\mathrm{true}$ on the final entry and $\mathrm{false}$ on every other — is nonempty. Then the marker flag of the last triple of this marked list equals $\mathrm{true}$.
hypotheses_covered: marked form of the block is nonempty
replaced:
On a nonempty block, the last element of $\mathrm{markLast}\,block$ has marker
flag equal to true.
